orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To construct a laddered bond portfolio, we'll allocate bonds across different maturity buckets. For a 5-year horizon, we'll divide the term into 5 one-year buckets. We'll target a laddered maturity structure with no more than 30% maturing in any single year. For investment-grade securities only, we'll select bonds from developed markets with a minimum credit rating of BBB+. We'll aim to spread the maturities to minimize concentration risk. Specifically, we propose allocating 20% to a 1-year bond, 20% to a 2-year bond, 20% to a 3-year bond, 20% to a 4-year bond, and 20% to a 5-year bond. This allocation ensures that no single year has more than 30% of the portfolio maturing.
